operations.content: Each agent gets its own separate keys, tokens, and credentials (Hermes vs Neocoder never share). Goal for Hermes is robust, efficient, and independent with full read/write/edit/manage on everything Soham owns, never a 1:1 copy of Neocoder's setup.
